draft_reason: KYON architecture crystallized 2026-06-30. Protocol primitives defined. Promotion to normative requires: standalone mode implemented, federated registry deployed on Solana devnet, entropy score empirically validated against test corpus.

identity.name: KYON
identity.mission: KYON makes your phone a sovereign witness. One tap. Permanent proof. Cross-platform consequence.
identity.position_in_organism: KYON is the organic sensor of CYNIC — the eye on the ground. It bridges physical-world events (Proof-of-Observation) to the on-chain epistemic layer (Solana PoH). Without KYON, CYNIC is blind to what happens in the hand of every human in the network.
identity.primitive_question: How to prove an information asymmetry occurred, without depending on a central authority that has incentive to deny it?

cortex.description: Connected to CYNIC Kernel. Full organism integration.

standalone.description: Disconnected, local-first. Sovereign without the Kernel.
standalone.sync_behavior: On reconnection, queue flushes to Solana registry in chronological order. Device-clock timestamps are anchored to PoH at flush time.

perceptual_hash.description: Content fingerprint computed locally on-device. Never stores, transmits, or exposes the content itself.
perceptual_hash.invariant: Same content sent to N victims across M platforms produces the same hash. The registry recognizes the pattern without storing the abuse once.
perceptual_hash.extension_note: Not limited to CSAM. Applicable to any harmful content pattern: unsolicited explicit images, coordinated harassment media, deepfakes.

behavioral_fingerprint.description: Composite sender identity that survives account deletion, platform migration, and basic obfuscation.

components.name: device_signature
components.description: Hardware identifiers, hashed. Survives account deletion.

components.name: network_pattern
components.description: Behavioral timing, IP range profile, connection patterns.

components.name: content_hash_history
components.description: Prior harmful content sent, PoH-anchored. Immutable record.

components.name: linguistic_profile
components.description: Writing pattern when text is involved. Stylometric signal.

behavioral_fingerprint.invariant: A predator who deletes their account and creates a new one cannot change their device, network behavior, or content hash history. The fingerprint follows them across platforms.

zk_proof.description: Zero-Knowledge proof that a valid report exists without exposing victim identity or content.
zk_proof.judicial_value: ZK-proof is admissible as judicial evidence. Proves the act occurred, timestamped and immutable on Solana, without exposing victim identity to defendant or public. Victim holds the ZK-key to their own report.
zk_proof.sovereignty_note: No company owns the report. No court order can force identity disclosure — the proof architecture makes it structurally impossible.

entropy_score.description: Accumulating reputation signal for harmful actors. Cross-platform, cross-victim, cannot be reset by account deletion.
entropy_score.formula: entropy_score(t) = sum(report_weight_i * decay_correction_i) for all reports up to t

report_weight_factors.description: CYNIC Q-Score of the report (independent multi-model validation).
Deduplicated by ZK across all reports.
Number of distinct platforms where harmful acts were recorded.
Hash matches against known severity classification tiers.

entropy_score.threshold_rationale: 0.618 = phi_inverse. CYNIC's epistemological ceiling — the point at which calibrated multi-source evidence is sufficient to act. Consistent with the organism-wide bounded doubt principle. Below: accumulating. Above: the math has spoken.
entropy_score.anti_gaming_note: Gas cost per report prevents abuse of false reports. Report gas is asymmetric: low for victims (mobile UX), higher for bulk API callers.

platform_integration.behavior: Participating platforms subscribe to KYON registry. Receive ban signals when a new user's fingerprint matches a high-entropy registry entry — before the predator's first message on their platform.

use_case_registry.description: Unsolicited explicit content, grooming, sexual harassment across digital platforms.
use_case_registry.example: Unsolicited explicit image sent on Instagram. KYON: one tap, perceptual hash, behavioral fingerprint, federated report. Entropy score accumulates. Account deletion does not reset it. Next platform receives ban signal before first message.

use_case_registry.description: Child Sexual Abuse Material detection and federated flagging.
use_case_registry.mechanism: perceptual_hash against known severity tiers + zk_proof + mandatory_judicial_handoff
use_case_registry.note: Highest severity tier. Threshold for mandatory judicial referral lower than community_ban threshold.

use_case_registry.description: Document corruption, police brutality, institutional wrongdoing with censorship-resistant sovereign proof.
use_case_registry.note: Identity protection is critical. ZK-proof allows proof of event without exposing source. Designed for environments where the institution is both the subject and would control evidence.

use_case_registry.description: Document real-world harassment incidents with geolocated, cryptographically signed sovereign proof.
Prove original authorship before publication. Sovereign anti-deepfake certificate.
use_case_registry.note: Inverse use: not reporting harm done TO you, but proving origin of content you created. Same primitives, different direction.

use_case_registry.description: Field journalists and citizens anchor real events with immutable pre-publication timestamps before distortion.
Anti-bot, anti-sybil proof of organic human presence for launchpads, governance, airdrops.
Document deceptive commercial practices, false advertising, defective products.
Non-repudiable documentation of workplace violations, contract modifications, employer misconduct.
Distributed cryptographic witness for observed electoral irregularities.

anti_surveillance_invariants.description: Structural properties that distinguish KYON from surveillance infrastructure. These are non-negotiable design constraints, not preferences.

invariants.rule: KYON has no passive monitoring mode. It does not scan messages. It does not watch feeds. It activates ONLY on a human victim's conscious tap to report.
invariants.enforcement: architectural — no background scan process permitted in any KYON release

invariants.rule: The victim holds the ZK-key to their own report. No company, state, or court order can extract victim identity from a KYON ZK-proof. The architecture makes this structurally impossible, not policy-dependent.
No single entity may delete a confirmed, on-chain KYON registry entry. No government, no corporation, no NGO.
KYON proof generation does not require the platform's permission, cooperation, or awareness. A victim can generate a sovereign proof of abuse on Instagram without Instagram knowing.
KYON is Apache 2.0. No entity can monopolize it. If a state forks it to add backdoors, the fork is public and the community sees it immediately.

KYON registry tracks not only predator entropy scores but also institutional response rates: how many reports transmitted to authorities resulted in action. Institutional inaction is itself a Proof of Observation.
